GlobalValueSet.description: Tracks the lifecycle of a corporate matching-gift request against a Gift Transaction. Shared between GiftTransaction.FQS_Match_Status__c (canonical) and GiftEntry.FQS_Match_Status__c (staging mirror). Values cover the whole workflow — Eligible (identified as match-eligible), Request Confirmed (submitted to employer), Received (match arrived, MatchingEmployerTransactionId set), Declined (employer refused), N/A (no match expected). Received is the terminal success state and pairs with MatchingEmployerTransactionId being populated on the donor's GiftTransaction.
